abilities.name: Wicked Wardens
abilities.effect: While this unit is wholly within 12" of a friendly Hag Queen on Cauldron of Blood, Slaughter Queen on Cauldron of Blood or Shrine of Dark Tribute, this unit's melee weapons have Anti-charge (+1 Rend).

abilities.name: Crimson Offerings
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Reaction: You declared the 'Blessings of Khaine' ability
abilities.effect: If an enemy unit was destroyed by this unit's combat attacks this turn, when resolving that ability, you can pick 2 blessings instead of 1.

abilities.name: Crystal Touch
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
abilities.declare: Pick an enemy Infantry or Cavalry unit in combat with this unit to be the target.
abilities.effect: Roll a dice. If the roll is equal to or less than the target's Health characteristic, the target has Strike-last for the rest of the turn.

abilities.name: Heartseekers
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Reaction: You declared a Shoot ability for this unit
abilities.effect: After that Shoot ability has been resolved, if all of this unit's attacks targeted the same enemy unit, roll a dice. Add 1 to the roll if any other friendly Blood Stalkers units picked that enemy unit to be the target of all of their shooting attacks this turn. On a 3+, until the start of your next turn, subtract 1 from the number of dice rolled when making charge rolls for the target, to a minimum of 1.

abilities.name: Exsanguinating Glare
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Shooting Phase
abilities.declare: If this unit is in combat, pick an enemy unit in combat with it to be the target. If this unit is not in combat, pick a visible enemy unit within 12" of it to be the target.
abilities.effect: Roll a D3. On a 2+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on the target equal to the roll. Then, if any enemy models were slain by that mortal damage, inflict an amount of mortal damage on the target equal to its Health characteristic.

abilities.name: Arcane Resonance
abilities.effect: Add 1 to casting rolls for this unit when it uses a Summon ability and add 1 to banishment rolls for this unit.

abilities.name: Aura of Agony
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Hero Phase
abilities.effect: Until the start of your next turn: • Enemy Manifestations cannot be set up within 12" of this unit. • This unit has Ward (4+) against mortal damage inflicted by Spell abilities, Prayer abilities and abilities used by Manifestations.

abilities.name: Born of Slaughter
abilities.declare: If there are fewer friendly Avatars of Khaine on the battlefield than there are friendly Bloodwrack Shrines on the battlefield, make a casting roll of 2D6.
abilities.effect: Set up an Avatar of Khaine wholly within 12" of the caster, visible to them and more than 9" from all enemy units.

abilities.name: Agonising Spasms
abilities.timing: Reaction: You declared a Shoot ability for this unit
abilities.effect: After that Shoot ability has been resolved, if all of this unit's attacks made as part of that Shoot ability targeted the same enemy unit and any enemy models were slain by those attacks, roll a dice. On a 3+, that enemy unit has a maximum control score of 1 for the rest of the turn.

abilities.name: Wracking Gaze
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Shooting Phase
abilities.declare: Pick a visible enemy unit within 15" of this unit to be the target.
abilities.effect: Roll a dice. If the roll is equal to or less than that enemy unit's Health characteristic, for the rest of the phase, you can re-roll failed hit rolls for attacks made by this unit that target that enemy unit.

abilities.name: Reflected Agony
abilities.declare: Make a casting roll of 2D6.
abilities.effect: Until the start of your next turn, enemy units and enemy Manifestations cannot be set up within 12" of this unit.

abilities.name: Outmanoeuvre
abilities.effect: When this unit uses the 'Redeploy' command, if you roll a 1-3 when determining the distance this unit can move, you can use a value of 4 instead.

abilities.name: Catechisms of Violence
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
abilities.effect: For the rest of the turn, each time a visible friendly Daughters of Khaine unit wholly within 12" of this unit uses a Fight ability, after that ability has been resolved, you can pick a visible friendly Daughters of Khaine Priest wholly within 12" of this unit. That Priest gains 1 ritual point.

units.name: Hag Queen on Cauldron of Blood

abilities.name: Wrathful Repulsion
abilities.declare: Pick a visible friendly Daughters of Khaine unit that is wholly within 12" of this unit and is in combat with an enemy unit that charged this turn to be the target. If there are any friendly Slaughter Queens on Cauldrons of Blood on the battlefield, you can pick another eligible unit to be a second target.
abilities.effect: The targets have Ward (5+) for the rest of the turn.

abilities.name: Roaring Idol
abilities.declare: Pick a friendly Daughters of Khaine Manifestation wholly within 12" of this unit to be the target.
abilities.effect: Roll a dice. On a 3+, the target cannot be picked to be the target of Banish abilities used by enemy units until the start of your next turn.

abilities.name: Paragon of Slaughter
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Hero Phase
abilities.declare: Pick a visible friendly Daughters of Khaine Infantry unit wholly within 12" of this unit to be the target.
abilities.effect: If this unit is in combat, add 1 to the Rend characteristic of the target's melee weapons for the rest of the turn. If this unit is not in combat, roll a dice. On a 3+, add 1 to the Rend characteristic of the target's melee weapons for the rest of the turn.

abilities.name: Shadow Leap
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Movement Phase
abilities.effect: Remove this unit from the battlefield and set it up again on the battlefield more than 9" from all enemy units.

abilities.name: Shadow Lariat
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), End of Any Turn
abilities.declare: If this unit is not in combat, pick a visible enemy Infantry or Cavalry Hero that has no more than 1 model and is within 12" of this unit to be the target.
abilities.effect: If the target is more than 3" from all other enemy units, apply the effect below. Otherwise, roll a dice. On a 3+, apply the effect below. Your opponent must remove the target from the battlefield and set it up again in combat with this unit.

abilities.name: Fire and Flight
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Reaction: You declared a Shoot ability for this unit
abilities.effect: After that Shoot ability has been resolved, this unit can move 2D6". It cannot move into combat during any part of that move.

abilities.name: Fight and Flight
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
abilities.effect: If this unit is in combat, it can move 12". It can pass through the combat ranges of enemy units but cannot end that move in combat. Then, roll a D3 for each enemy unit that this unit passed across during that move. On a 2+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on that enemy unit equal to the roll.

abilities.name: The Croneseer
abilities.effect: Each time you perform a blood rite, immediately after the ability that destroyed a unit has been resolved, give this unit 1 prophecy token. • While this unit has 2 or more prophecy tokens, this unit cannot be picked to be the target of shooting attacks or Spell abilities used by enemy units. • While this unit has 3 or more prophecy tokens, you can re-roll unmodified chanting rolls of 1 for this unit. • While this unit has 4 or more prophecy tokens, if the unmodified hit roll for an attack that targets this unit is 1-4, the attack fails and the attack sequence ends.

abilities.name: Omens of Doom
abilities.declare: Make a chanting roll of D6.
abilities.effect: Pick 1 of the following effects. If the chanting roll was 10+, pick up to 2 different effects instead. Prophecy of Exile: Pick a visible enemy Wizard or Priest within 18" of this unit. Subtract 1 from that unit's power level until the start of your next turn. Prophecy of Dark Wings: Pick a visible friendly Daughters of Khaine Infantry unit wholly within 12" of this unit. That unit can immediately use the 'Normal Move' ability as if it were your movement phase and counts as having used a Run ability this turn. Prophecy of Futile Endeavours: Pick a visible enemy unit within 12" of this unit. Until the start of your next turn, that unit's attacks cannot score critical hits (treat them as regular hits instead).

abilities.name: Gift of Foresight
abilities.timing: Once Per Battle, Your Movement Phase
abilities.declare: Pick a friendly non-Unique Daughters of Khaine Aelf Infantry or Cavalry unit that has been destroyed to be the target.
abilities.effect: Set up a replacement unit with half the number of models from the target unit (rounding up) wholly within 9" of a battlefield edge and more than 9" from all enemy units.

abilities.name: Blood Ritual
abilities.declare: Pick a visible friendly Daughters of Khaine Aelf Infantry or Cavalry unit wholly within 12" of this unit to be the target. Then, make a chanting roll of D6.
abilities.effect: Pick 1 of the following effects to apply until the start of your next turn: *Prophecy of Tyranny:* Enemy units cannot use commands while they are in combat with the target. *Prophecy of Shelter:* Other than the Companion ability, weapon abilities used by enemy units while they are in combat with the target have no effect. *Prophecy of Retribution:* Subtract 1 from ward rolls made for damage points inflicted by the target's combat attacks. If the chanting roll was 9+, all of the above effects apply

abilities.name: The Croneseer
abilities.effect: Give this unit D3 ritual points.

abilities.name: Ironscale's Fury
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
abilities.declare: Pick each friendly Daughters of Khaine unit within this unit's combat range to be the targets.
abilities.effect: For the rest of the phase, each time a model in a target unit is slain by a combat attack, roll a dice. If that unit is a Blood Sisters or Blood Stalkers unit, roll 2 dice instead. For each 5+, inflict 1 mortal damage on the attacking unit.

abilities.name: Frenzied Slaughter
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Hero Phase
abilities.declare: Pick a visible friendly Daughters of Khaine unit wholly within 12" of this unit to be the target.
abilities.effect: Roll a dice. If this unit is in combat, you can re-roll the dice. If the roll is lower than your fury level, add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of weapons used by this unit and the target until the start of your next turn.

abilities.name: Surge of Hatred
abilities.declare: Pick either a friendly Shadow Queen wholly within 12" of this unit and in combat or a visible friendly non-Hero Daughters of Khaine unit wholly within 12" of this unit and in combat to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
abilities.effect: If the target is a friendly Shadow Queen, it can immediately use a Fight ability as if it were your combat phase. Otherwise, inflict D3 mortal damage on each enemy unit in combat with the target.

abilities.name: The Iron Heart of Khaine
abilities.effect: Each time you perform a blood rite, immediately after the ability that destroyed a unit has been resolved, pick 1 of the following effects: • Until the start of your next turn, this unit is only visible to enemy units while those units are within its combat range. • Heal (D6) this unit or a friendly Shadow Queen. • A friendly Shadow Queen can immediately use the 'Normal Move' or 'Retreat' ability as if it was your movement phase even if it has already used that ability or another Core ability this phase. Designer's Note: *If the Shadow Queen retreats with the 'Iron Heart of Khaine' ability, she cannot subsequently use the 'Fight' ability in the same combat phase.* • Remove this unit from the battlefield and set it up again on the battlefield more than 9" from all enemy units. • For the rest of the turn, set this unit's Control characteristic to 5 and a friendly Shadow Queen's Control characteristic to 15.

abilities.name: Divine Matriarch
abilities.declare: Pick a visible friendly Daughters of Khaine Priest or Wizard wholly within 12" of this unit to be the target.
abilities.effect: Add 1 to casting rolls and chanting rolls for the target until the start of your next turn.

abilities.name: In Dark Communion
abilities.declare: Pick a friendly Daughters of Khaine Wizard or Priest within 3" of this terrain feature to be the target.
abilities.effect: The target is in dark communion until this terrain feature uses this ability again or until this terrain feature is removed from the battlefield, whichever comes first. While the target is in dark communion, you can re-roll 1 casting roll or 1 chanting roll for the target each turn.

abilities.name: Call to Murder
abilities.effect: Pick a blessing from the 'Blessings of Khaine' ability that is active. That blessing is no longer active. Then, pick a blessing that is not active. That blessing is now active. Designer's Note: When you use this ability, you are not using the 'Blessings of Khaine' ability.

abilities.name: Dance of Death
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
abilities.declare: Pick an enemy unit that charged this turn and is in combat with this unit to be the target.
abilities.effect: Subtract 1 from hit rolls and wound rolls for the target's combat attacks for the rest of the turn.

abilities.name: Fanatical Blademaster
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Hero Phase
abilities.declare: Pick a visible friendly Daughters of Khaine unit wholly within 12" of this unit to be the target.
abilities.effect: Roll a dice. On a 3+, pick a blessing from the 'Blessings of Khaine' ability that is not active. The effect of that blessing applies to the target until the start of your next turn as if it were active. If you have used the 'Blessings of Khaine' ability 3 or more times this battle, you can pick 2 blessings instead of 1.

units.name: Slaughter Queen on Cauldron of Blood

abilities.name: Consecrated Revulsion
abilities.effect: Add 1 to save rolls for friendly Daughters of Khaine Infantry units while they are wholly within 12" of this unit.

abilities.name: Icon of Slaughter
abilities.effect: Each time a friendy Daughters of Khaine unit wholly within 12" of this unit uses the 'Rally' command, you can make 3 additional rally rolls of D6. In addition, if there are any friendly Hag Queens on Cauldrons of Blood on the battlefield when that command is used, you receive D3 additional rally points.

abilities.name: Frenzied Fervour
abilities.effect: Add 1 to the Rend characteristic of this unit's melee weapons if it charged in the same turn.

battleTraits.name: Blood Rites
battleTraits.effect: You perform a blood rite each time: • An enemy unit is destroyed and any damage points were allocated to that unit by a friendly anointed unit's combat attacks in the same turn. • A friendly anointed unit is destroyed. • A friendly unit contesting an objective you control is destroyed. • An enemy unit is destroyed by a friendly Daughters of Khaine unit's attacks and any models in that enemy unit were contesting an objective you do not control in the same phase. • A unit (friendly or enemy) is destroyed and it was within 3" of a Place of Power at the start of the phase. Only one blood rite can be performed per unit destroyed.

battleTraits.name: Anointed Ritualist
battleTraits.declare: If there are no friendly anointed units on the battlefield, pick a friendly non-Unique Daughters of Khaine Hero on the battlefield to be the target.
battleTraits.effect: The target is anointed for the rest of the battle, even if it has been destroyed. Friendly anointed units on the battlefield treat Exalted abilities on the warscrolls of friendly anointed units that have been destroyed as if they were on their warscroll.

battleTraits.name: Bloody Succession
battleTraits.effect: Each time a friendly anointed unit is destroyed, after removing it from play, you can immediately use the 'Anointed Ritualist' ability as if it were the start of the first battle round.

battleTraits.name: Strident War Cry
battleTraits.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Reaction: You declared a Charge ability for an anointed unit
battleTraits.effect: Pick a friendly non-Hero Daughters of Khaine unit that is not in combat, is wholly within 12" of that anointed unit and has not charged this turn to be the target. If that anointed unit charges, after that Charge ability has been resolved, the target can immediately use the 'Charge' ability even if it is not your charge phase. In addition, you can re-roll charge rolls for the target for the rest of the phase.

battleTraits.name: Blessings of Khaine
battleTraits.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), End of Any Turn
battleTraits.declare: You can only use this ability if you performed any blood rites this turn.
battleTraits.effect: Pick 1 of the following blessings that is not active. That blessing is active. While a blessing is active, its effect applies to friendly Daughters of Khaine units. The effects of more than 1 blessing can apply to a unit at the same time. • Blessing of Ruthlessness: Add 1 to hit rolls for those units' combat attacks. • Blessing of Hatred: Add 1 to wound rolls for those units' combat attacks. • Blessing of Haste: Add 3" to those units' Move characteristic. • Blessing of Zeal: If those units charged in the same turn, they have Ward (5+) for the rest of the turn. • Blessing of Shadow: Subtract 1 from hit rolls for shooting attacks that target those units. • Blessing of Cruelty: Those units can use Charge and/or Shoot abilities even if they have used a Retreat ability in the same turn. • Blessing of Clarity: Add 1 to chanting rolls and casting rolls for those units.

abilities.name: Bloody-Handed Worshippers
abilities.timing: Reaction: You declared a Fight ability for an anointed unit
abilities.effect: Pick a friendly non-Hero Daughters of Khaine unit that has not used a Fight ability this turn and is within that anointed unit's combat range to the the target. The target can be picked to use a Fight ability immediately after the Fight ability used by that anointed unit has been resolved. If it is picked to do so, the target's melee weapons have Crit (Auto-wound) for the rest of the turn. If the melee weapons already have Crit (Auto-wound), they have Crit (Mortal) for the rest of the turn instead.

abilities.name: The Breath of Khaine
abilities.effect: While each model in a friendly Daughters of Khaine unit is contesting an objective you control, those models are not visible to enemy models more than 9" away.

abilities.name: Final Frenzy
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), End of Any Turn
abilities.declare: Pick each friendly Daughters of Khaine unit contesting an objective to be the targets.
abilities.effect: Return up to D3 slain models to each target that has a Health characteristic of up to 2. Return up to 1 slain model to each target that that has a Health characteristic of 3 or more.

abilities.name: Heretic's Bane
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Start of Enemy Turn
abilities.declare: Pick an enemy Wizard or Priest on the battlefield to be the target.
abilities.effect: Roll a dice for each objective you control. For each 3+, subtract 1 from castitng rolls and chanting rolls for the target for the rest of the turn.

abilities.name: Hand of Khaine
abilities.declare: Pick an enemy Hero in combat with this unit to be the target.
abilities.effect: Roll 2D6. If the roll exceeds the target's Health characteristic, it is automatically destroyed. If the target is destroyed by this ability, this unit can use 2 Fight abilities this phase. After the first is used, however, this unit has Strike-Last for the rest of the turn.

abilities.name: Murderous Duellist
abilities.declare: Pick an enemy unit that has no more than 1 model and is in combat with this unit to be the target.
abilities.effect: Roll 2D6. If the roll equals or exceeds the target's Control characteristic, for the rest of the turn, if this unit is in combat with the target when the target is picked to use a Fight ability, all of the target's attacks must target this unit.

abilities.name: Shadow-Blooded
abilities.timing: Reaction: You declared the 'Redeploy' command for a Daughters of Khaine unit wholly within 12" of this unit
abilities.effect: If you roll a 1-3 when determining the distance that unit can move, you can use a value of 4 instead.

abilities.name: Crimson Draught
abilities.effect: You can re-roll charge rolls for this unit.

abilities.name: Darkling Elixir
abilities.declare: Pick a visible friendly Daughters of Khaine unit wholly within 12" of this unit to be the target.
abilities.effect: Roll a dice. On a 3+, the target can immediately use the 'Retreat' ability as if it were your movement phase.

abilities.name: Witchbrew
abilities.declare: Pick a visible friendly non-Unique Daughters of Khaine unit wholly within 12" of this unit to be the target.
abilities.effect: Roll a dice. On a 3+, ignore negative modifiers to save rolls for the target until the start of your next turn.

abilities.name: Steed of Shadows
abilities.declare: Pick a friendly Daughters of Khaine Wizard to cast this spell, pick a visible friendly Daughters of Khaine unit wholly within 12" of them to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
abilities.effect: The target can use Charge abilities this turn even if it used a Run ability in the same turn.

abilities.name: Mindrazor
abilities.declare: Pick a friendly Daughters of Khaine Wizard to cast this spell, pick a visible friendly Daughters of Khaine unit wholly within 12" of them to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
abilities.effect: The target's melee weapons have Charge (+1 Damage) until the start of your next turn.

abilities.name: Black Horror of Ulgu
abilities.declare: Pick a friendly Daughters of Khaine Wizard to cast this spell, pick a point on the battlefield within 18" of them, pick up to 3 enemy units within 3" of that point to be the targets, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
abilities.effect: The targets cannot use Run abilities until the start of your next turn.

abilities.name: Covenant of the Iron Heart
abilities.declare: Pick a friendly Daughters of Khaine Priest to chant this prayer, pick a visible friendly Daughters of Khaine unit wholly within 12" of them to be the target, then make a chanting roll of D6.
abilities.effect: Add 10 to the target's control score until the start of your next turn. In addition, if the chanting roll was 6+, ignore the first damage point that would be allocated to the target in each phase until the start of your next turn.

abilities.name: Catechism of Murder
abilities.declare: Pick a friendly Daughters of Khaine Priest to chant this prayer, pick a visible friendly Daughters of Khaine unit wholly within 12" of them to be the target, then make a chanting roll of D6.
abilities.effect: The target's melee weapons have Crit (Auto-wound) until the start of your next turn. In addition, if the chanting roll was 7+, the target's combat attacks score critical hits on unmodified hit rolls of 5+ until the start of your next turn.

abilities.name: Dance of Doom
abilities.declare: Pick a friendly Daughters of Khaine Priest to chant this prayer, pick a visible friendly non-Unique Daughters of Khaine unit wholly within 12" of them to be the target, then make a chanting roll of D6.
abilities.effect: Add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of the target's melee weapons for the rest of the turn. In addition, if the chanting roll was 10+, the target can use 2 Fight abilities this turn. After the first is used, however, the target has Strike-Last for the rest of the turn.

abilities.name: Summon Bladewind
abilities.declare: If there is not a friendly Bladewind on the battlefield, pick a friendly Daughters Of Khaine Wizard to cast this spell, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
abilities.effect: Set up a Bladewind wholly within 12" of the caster, visible to them and more than 9" from all enemy units.

abilities.name: Summon Bloodwrack Viper
abilities.declare: If there is not a friendly Bloodwrack Viper on the battlefield, pick a friendly Daughters of Khaine Wizard to cast this spell, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
abilities.effect: Set up a Bloodwrack Viper wholly within 12" of the caster, visible to them and more than 9" from all enemy units

abilities.name: Summon Heart of Fury
abilities.declare: If there is not a friendly Heart of Fury on the battlefield, pick a friendly Daughters of Khaine Wizard to cast this spell, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
abilities.effect: Set up a Heart of Fury wholly within 18" of the caster and visible to them.

abilities.name: Unnatural Edge
abilities.declare: If this Manifestation charged this turn, pick an enemy unit in combat with it to be the target.
abilities.effect: If any damage points are allocated to the target this phase by this Manifestation's combat attacks, ward rolls cannot be made for the target for the rest of the battle.

abilities.name: Crushing Coils
abilities.declare: Pick an enemy Hero or Monster in combat with this Manifestation to be the target.
abilities.effect: Roll a dice. On a 3+, the target has Strike-last for the rest of the turn.

abilities.name: Bind and Bite
abilities.effect: This unit's combat attacks score critical hits on unmodified hit rolls of 4+ if the target of those attacks has Strike-Last.

abilities.name: Locus of the Murder God
abilities.effect: Subtract 1 from wound rolls for attacks that target friendly Daughters of Khaine Infantry units while they are wholly within 12" of this Manifestation.

abilities.name: Summon Aethervoid Pendulum
abilities.declare: If there is not a friendly Aethervoid Pendulumon the battlefield, pick a friendly Wizard to cast this spell, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
abilities.effect: Set up an Aethervoid Pendulum wholly within 12" of the caster, visible to them and more than 9" from all enemy units.

abilities.name: Summon Chronomantic Cogs
abilities.declare: If there is not a friendly Chronomantic Cogs endless spell on the battlefield, pick a friendly Wizard to cast this spell, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
abilities.effect: Set up a Chronomantic Cogs endless spell wholly within 12" of the caster and visible to them.

abilities.name: Summon Quicksilver Swords
abilities.declare: If there is not a friendly Quicksilver Swords endless spell on the battlefield, pick a friendly Wizard to cast this spell, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
abilities.effect: Set up a Quicksilver Swords endless spell wholly within 12" of the caster, visible to them and more than 9" from all enemy units.

abilities.name: Summon Horrorghast
abilities.declare: If there is not a friendly Horrorghast endless spell on the battlefield, pick a friendly Wizard to cast this spell, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
abilities.effect: Set up a Horrorghast endless spell wholly within 12" of the caster, visible to them and more than 9" from all enemy units.

abilities.name: Summon Lauchon the Soulseeker
abilities.declare: If there is not a friendly Lauchon the Soulseeker endless spell on the battlefield, pick a friendly Wizard to cast this spell, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
abilities.effect: Set up a Lauchon the Soulseeker endless spell wholly within 12" of the caster, visible to them and more than 9" from all enemy units.

abilities.name: Summon Shards of Valagharr
abilities.declare: If there is not a friendly Shards of Valagharr endless spell on the battlefield, pick a friendly Wizard to cast this spell, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
abilities.effect: Set up a Shards of Valagharr endless spell wholly within 18" of the caster and visible to them. A Shards of Valagharr endless spell has 2 parts that must be set up within 9" of each other.

abilities.name: Summon Soulscream Bridge
abilities.declare: If there is not a friendly Soulscream Bridge endless spell on the battlefield, pick a friendly Wizard to cast this spell, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
abilities.effect: Set up a Soulscream Bridge wholly within 18" of the caster and visible to them. A Soulscream Bridge has 2 parts that must be set up within 9" of each other.

abilities.name: Summon Krondspine Incarnate of Ghur
abilities.declare: If there is not a friendly Krondspine Incarnate of Ghur endless spell on the battlefield, pick a friendly Wizard to cast this spell, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
abilities.effect: Set up a Krondspine Incarnate of Ghur endless spell wholly within 12" of the caster, visible to them and more than 9" from all enemy units.

abilities.name: Summon Purple Sun of Shyish
abilities.declare: If there is not a friendly Purple Sun of Shyish endless spell on the battlefield, pick a friendly Wizard to cast this spell, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
abilities.effect: Set up a Purple Sun of Shyish endless spell wholly within 12" of the caster, visible to them and more than 9" from all enemy units.

abilities.name: Summon Malevolent Maelstrom
abilities.declare: If there is not a friendly a Malevolent Maelstrom endless spell on the battlefield, pick a friendly Wizard to cast this spell, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
abilities.effect: Set up a a Malevolent Maelstrom endless spell wholly within 12" of the caster, visible to them and more than 9" from all enemy units.

abilities.name: Summon Soulsnare Shackles
abilities.declare: If there is not a friendly Soulsnare Shackles endless spell on the battlefield, pick a friendly Wizard to cast this spell, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
abilities.effect: Set up a Soulsnare Shackles endless spell wholly within 18" of the caster and visible to them. A Soulsnare Shackles endless spell has 3 parts that must each be set up within 3" of at least 1 other part.

abilities.name: Summon Suffocating Gravetide
abilities.declare: If there is not a friendly Suffocating Gravetide endless spell on the battlefield, pick a friendly Wizard to cast this spell, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
abilities.effect: Set up a Suffocating Gravetide endless spell wholly within 12" of the caster, visible to them and more than 9" from all enemy units.

abilities.name: Summon Burning Head
abilities.declare: If there is not a friendly The Burning Head endless spell on the battlefield, pick a friendly Wizard to cast this spell, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
abilities.effect: Set up a The Burning Head endless spell wholly within 12" of the caster, visible to them and more than 9" from all enemy units.

abilities.name: Summon Emerald Lifeswarm
abilities.declare: If there is not a friendly Emerald Lifeswarm endless spell on the battlefield, pick a friendly Wizard to cast this spell, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
abilities.effect: Set up a Emerald Lifeswarm endless spell wholly within 12" of the caster, visible to them and more than 9" from all enemy units.

abilities.name: Summon Ravenak's Gnashing Jaws
abilities.declare: If there is not a friendly Ravenak's Gnashing Jaws endless spell on the battlefield, pick a friendly Wizard to cast this spell, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
abilities.effect: Set up a Ravenak's Gnashing Jaws endless spell wholly within 12" of the caster, visible to them and more than 9" from all enemy units.

abilities.name: Summon Geminids of Uhl-Gysh
abilities.declare: If there is not a friendly Geminids of Uhl-Gysh endless spell on the battlefield, pick a friendly Wizardto cast this spell, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
abilities.effect: Set up a Geminids of Uhl-Gysh endless spell wholly within 12" of the caster, visible to them and more than 9" from all enemy units. A Geminids of Uhl-Gysh endless spell has 2 parts that must be set up within 9" of each other.

abilities.name: Summon Prismatic Palisade
abilities.declare: If there is not a friendly Prismatic Palisade endless spell on the battlefield, pick a friendly Wizard to cast this spell, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
abilities.effect: Set up a Prismatic Palisade wholly within 18" of the caster and visible to them.

abilities.name: Summon Umbral Spellportal
abilities.declare: If there is not a friendly Umbral Spellportal endless spell on the battlefield, pick a friendly Wizard to cast this spell, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
abilities.effect: Set up an Umbral Spellportal wholly within 18" of the caster and visible to them. An Umbral Spellportal has 2 parts that must be set up within 9" of each other.
